name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where Jev is served from: typesafe (System One API) or cloudflare (Cloudflare AI typesafe/jev, billed through AI Gateway).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key, or a Cloudflare API token for the cloudflare provider. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY / CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account id
cloudflareAccountId.description: Account id for the cloudflare provider. Leave unset to use CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

cloudflareGatewayId.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway id
cloudflareGatewayId.description: Routes cloudflare requests through this AI Gateway for logs and analytics. Leave unset to use CLOUDFLARE_AI_GATEWAY_ID, or empty for no gateway.

baseUrl.title: Endpoint override
baseUrl.description: Full request URL replacing the provider's default, for example an AI Gateway URL.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

logDecisions.title: Log per-call decisions
logDecisions.description: Log every tool call's keep/drop decision with its probabilities after each compaction (long; for diagnosis).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

resultHeadChars.title: Output start shown to Jev
resultHeadChars.description: Characters of each tool output shown to Jev so it judges an output it has seen the start of; 0 shows only status and size.

keepCallInputChars.title: Always keep calls with an input up to
keepCallInputChars.description: A tool call whose input is at most this many characters is never removed, only its result, so the assistant still knows what it already ran; 0 lets Jev decide for every call.

windowTokens.title: Window size
windowTokens.description: Estimated tokens of history per window when a long conversation is judged in windows; 0 never splits and shrinks the single state instead.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: TypeSafe Jev model name. Ignored by the cloudflare provider, which always sends typesafe/jev.
